'''Moogma Leggings''' are a {{Rare}} set of [[Leggings]], which are obtainable as a drop from the [[Moogma]] [[Sea Creature]]. They reduce damage from {{MobType|Magmatic}} mobs by {{Green|5%}}, and increases damage against them by {{Red|1.1x}}.

== Trivia ==
*It has the same effect as the [[Taurus Helmet]] and [[Flaming Chestplate]], and it is part of the secret [[Lava Sea Creature Armor]] set, which consists of the aforementioned armor pieces plus [[Slug Boots]].
